name: Email Triage (AI-infused)
_comment: Book §10.4.2 / §10.11. An AI-INFUSED workflow: mostly deterministic, with ONE judgment node (classify the free-text email) feeding a deterministic rule-based route. The AI output is validated against an allow-list before any branch acts — the injection defense (§10.18).

parameters._comment: T — webhook trigger. AUTHENTICATE this in production (§10.18): a webhook is an unauthenticated front door by default.
I — idempotency claim on the email message_id.
parameters.query: INSERT INTO wf_processed(key) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING key;

parameters._comment: THE JUDGMENT NODE. A model classifies the unstructured email into a fixed category set. Small model, temperature 0, structured output — Ch.2/Ch.4 discipline. The prompt is a REGISTERED prompt (Ch.3), not an ad-hoc string.

INJECTION DEFENSE: validate the AI output against the allow-list BEFORE any branch acts on it. A crafted email that makes the model emit something off-list gets quarantined, not routed. This is the difference between a judgment node and an open door.
DETERMINISTIC route by the validated category — a fixed rule table, fully auditable. The AI informed the decision; it did not MAKE an arbitrary action.
R — Reportable: log every routed item + category for observability and the audit trail.
parameters.jsCode:
console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'email_routed', category:$json.category, at:new Date().toISOString()}));
return [{ json: { logged: true } }];

parameters._comment: Quarantine / human-review path for off-allowlist or ambiguous items — the E dead-letter equivalent for the judgment step.
